title: federal reserve / monetary policy / market structure | Research Paper | The Pre-Crisis Monetary Policy Implementation Framework
summary: This Federal Reserve Bank of New York Staff Report (No. 809, March 2017, revised May 2018) describes the Federal Reserve's monetary policy operating framework before the balance sheet expansion during the financial crisis. The report explains how the FOMC set a target for the overnight federal funds rate and how the New York Fed's open market trading desk conducted daily forecasting and repo operations with primary dealers to maintain the equilibrium rate close to its target. The pre-crisis framework relied on scarce aggregate reserves where small changes affected fed funds rates, required substantial intraday overdrafts, and became unsustainable once the Fed's balance sheet expanded.
